source: The default scene (852 nm tweezer along x, probe along z on F = 2 → F' = 2, B = 3 G along z) with the tweezer at 0.6 mW (a trap about 128 uK deep) and the probe at 1 mW/cm2, the atom at 30 uK in F = 2, m = 0, 500 us and 26 samples on the CPU, as the app sends it: the step check's repro (claude/motion3d-stepcheck3, repro/F3fix_step_shallow_probe.json). The probe pumps every atom into F = 1 within the first sample, dark from then on.
